أَجْبَهُ , applied to a man, Large, (S,) or wide (JK, M, K) and beautiful, (M, K,) in the جَبْهَة [or forehead]: (JK, S, M, K:) or protuberant, or prominent, therein: (M, K:) applied to a horse, having a protuberant, or prominent, forehead, rising beyond the bone of the nose: (TA:) fem. جَبْهَآءُ; (S, K;) of which the dim. is جُبَيْهَآءُ. (S.) ―
-b2- الأَجْبَهُ The lion; (K;) because of the width of his جَبْهَة. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
